narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Seventeen degrees works, because arms can be drawn seventeen degrees apart.
<bookmark mark='lay'/>Lay twenty one gaps of seventeen degrees round the circle. They cover only three hundred fifty seven degrees.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Three degrees are left over, so the last gap is too small, and the bubble is struck.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble says 17° works; gaps of 17° are laid round a circle, 21 of them, and they cover 357° with a gap of 3° left open; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, divide three hundred sixty by the angle.
<bookmark mark='whole'/>If the answer is a whole number, that many equal arms can be drawn. If not, the angle is impossible.
removed_beats.on_screen: the stage clears except the anchor; the recap board shows the check: divide 360 by the angle and look for a whole number answer
